memory_candidates.content: When a hard-mode task 772 disables a dispatch call site (e.g. Parallel Wave Dispatch) that an earlier plan referenced as a target for a shared edit, the remaining single call site still satisfies 'every dispatch gets X' intent — record this as an altered deviation rather than treating it as a plan failure.

Inserting a new entry into .claude/context/index.json cleanly (matching existing indentation/formatting) is best done via a small Python script that loads with json.load(object_pairs_hook=OrderedDict), inserts at a computed index adjacent to a sibling entry, and re-dumps with indent=2 plus a trailing newline -- this avoids reformatting the whole file and keeps the git diff minimal.
